name: Statement Of Investment Fund Transactions Cancellation V 02
definition: Scope|An account servicer, for example, a transfer agent sends the StatementOfInvestmentFundTransactionsCancellation message to the account owner, for example, an investment manager or its authorised representative to cancel a previously sent StatementOfInvestmentFundTransactions message.|Usage|The StatementOfInvestmentFundTransactionsCancellation message is used to cancel a previously sent StatementOfInvestmentFundTransactions message. This message must contain the reference of the message to be cancelled.|This message may also contain all the details of the message to be cancelled, but this is not recommended.
